did: Landed #3152's second part as #3170: a home-link run asked before the pairing record is read now waits as the link's own state, every run ends in a named outcome instead of null, one pure sanitizer (settle.ts) translates the record's read and a run's end, My data counts not-known-yet places and re-reads the phone side alone, and PO1 moved from a grep onto the type (RO1 declared). Three independent reviews caught a stale preempted flag, a double fault report and a dead branch, all fixed before merge.
